title: How to maximize GitHub Copilot’s agentic capabilities
summary: A senior engineer’s guide to architecting and extending Copilot’s real-world applications.[^c-d51347d48c] Modern engineering work rarely lives in a single file.[^c-f0bc8ed3ca] Real systems evolve across years of incrementally layered decisions—some good, some accidental.[^c-21ed928a85]

title: What the fastest-growing tools reveal about how software is being built
GitHub Mobile: Comment on unchanged lines in pull request files
summary: You can now comment anywhere within a changed file on GitHub Mobile.[^c-c0b48824a5] Previously in the Files Changed view, you could only comment on the lines directly surrounding a change.[^c-391dc51336]

title: The Dependabot Proxy is now open source with an MIT license
summary: The Dependabot Proxy is now available as open source under the MIT license.[^c-b672a1fb8d]

title: Dependabot now supports OIDC authentication
summary: Dependabot can now use OpenID Connect (OIDC) to authenticate with private registries, eliminating the need to store long-lived credentials as repository secrets.[^c-18ba0b5032]

title: Simplified Copilot model enablement experience for individual users
Performance improvements to MEF-based editor productivity extensions
Claude and Codex are now available in public preview on GitHub
summary: Claude by Anthropic and OpenAI Codex are now available as coding agents for Copilot Pro+ and Copilot Enterprise customers.[^c-67a4735bbe] You can start agent sessions and assign work to these agents from github.com, GitHub Mobile, and VS Code.[^c-fcae5d24ea]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — January update
summary: January 2026 brought colorized code completions, partial acceptance of code completions, productivity improvements, and more.[^c-fc6ba5f775]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code v1.109 – January Release
Showing tool calls and other improvements to Copilot chat on the web
Roadmap for AI in Visual Studio (February)
Anthropic models now show thinking tokens
summary: Many of you are using Anthropic's Claude models in VS Code.[^c-1539511999]

title: Mermaid diagrams in chat responses
summary: Chat responses can now render interactive Mermaid diagrams with the renderMermaidDiagram tool.[^c-c482c5b4e4]

title: Plan agent
summary: The built-in Plan agent lets you create a structured implementation plan before starting to code.[^c-462c841c4a]

title: Model descriptions in the model picker
summary: On hover or keyboard focus of a model in the model picker, you can now see its details at a glance.[^c-971c38f501]

title: Terminal command output
summary: Terminal output now automatically expands when a command takes time to execute, giving you immediate visibility into what's happening.[^c-a5e56c9986] Quick commands stay collapsed to reduce visual noise.[^c-09c48f3d4c]

title: Tell us what you think about our new themes (Experimental)
Edit mode is now hidden (Experimental)
summary: Edit mode is now hidden by default from the agent dropdown in chat.[^c-c686467ca6] Using agents provides a superset of edit mode capabilities and produces better results for code editing tasks.[^c-471fa20bfd] If your organization has disabled agent mode, edit mode remains visible in the agent dropdown.[^c-6b1e4cebb4]

title: Switching and delegating between agent types
Keeping track of agent sessions
summary: Keeping track of your active agent sessions is essential when working with multiple agents, especially when you have multiple parallel session across different environments.[^c-c4b72cf8a4]

title: Subagents
summary: Agents can run subtasks using subagents to break down complex tasks into smaller parts.[^c-d1ca32e932] The nice thing about subagents is that they operate in their own dedicated context window and don't add up to the main agent's context window.[^c-b11ca4ba29] Subagents can now run in parallel, which can significantly speed up tasks that can be split into independent tasks.[^c-476df74858]

title: Cloud agents
summary: When you start a new cloud agent session, you now have more options to configure your session.[^c-f1a7c7efdf]

title: Set up your workspace for AI with /init
Agent Skills are generally available
summary: Agent Skills are now generally available and enabled by default.[^c-3b82bd01e9] Skills provide specialized capabilities, domain knowledge, and refined workflows to help the AI produce high-quality outputs.[^c-20b64e7099] Each skill folder contains tested instructions for specific domains like testing strategies, API design, or performance optimization.[^c-3eeec2982e]

title: Control how custom agents are invoked
summary: Custom agents now support additional attributes in the frontmatter header that give you more control over how agents can be invoked.[^c-bd535f55cd]

title: Multiple model support for custom agents
summary: Custom agents can now specify more than one model in the frontmatter header.[^c-42e43a964b] The first available model in the list is used, providing fallback options if a preferred model is unavailable.[^c-2a10290b98]

title: Chat customization diagnostics
summary: Chat customization files can originate from various locations, including your user profile, workspace, extensions, and your GitHub organization.[^c-846626272b] When troubleshooting issues with custom agents, prompts, instructions, or skills, it can be challenging to determine which files are currently loaded and whether any errors occurred during loading.[^c-a484984ed1]

title: Language Models editor
summary: The Language Models editor in VS Code provides a centralized interface for managing and configuring language models used in chat.[^c-78c11fbad8]

title: Agent customization skill (Experimental)
summary: A new agent-customization skill teaches the agent how to help you customize your AI coding experience.[^c-653dd3798a] When you ask about creating custom agents, instructions, prompts, or skills, the agent automatically loads this skill to provide accurate guidance.[^c-256724fff8]

title: Claude compatibility
summary: If you use both VS Code and Claude, you no longer need to maintain separate configuration files.[^c-83669b6334] VS Code now reads Claude configuration files directly, so your agents, skills, instructions, and hooks work across both tools without duplication.[^c-0410248953]

title: Agent orchestration
summary: Agent orchestration is a powerful pattern for building complex AI workflows where multiple specialized agents collaborate to achieve a common goal.[^c-5332cc24fb] Instead of relying on a single agent to handle everything, orchestration distributes work across purpose-built agents, each optimized for a specific role like planning, implementation, code review, or research.[^c-2e87ec5f1b]

title: Support for custom registry base URLs for MCP packages
summary: VS Code now supports the registryBaseUrl property in MCP server manifest files.[^c-e29dad1b77]

title: Copilot Memory (Preview)
summary: If you find yourself repeatedly providing the same context to the AI, you can now use Copilot Memory to store and recall important information across sessions.[^c-85e9b16401] With the new memory tool, your chat can now access and update Copilot Memory directly.[^c-bb7f0e986c]

title: External indexing for non-GitHub workspaces (Preview)
summary: Workspaces that are _not_ hosted on GitHub can now be remotely indexed for faster code search when using agents.[^c-5c1c47ac85] When you use #codebase in a non-GitHub workspace, VS Code builds an index of your codebase that enables quick semantic search, providing the same powerful code search capabilities that are available for GitHub-hosted repositories.[^c-c914f66988]

title: Read files outside workspace
summary: Agents can now read files and list directories outside your current workspace with your permission.[^c-b4cb86972b] Previously, access attempts were automatically denied.[^c-711b66d3f6] Now, when an agent needs to access external files or folders, VS Code prompts you to allow or deny the request.[^c-ba051cf2e4]

title: Terminal sandboxing (Experimental)
summary: Agents have the same permissions as your user account.[^c-0196e33136] To help mitigate risks associated with terminal commands executed by agents, we have introduced experimental terminal sandboxing capabilities.[^c-3a14311a60] Terminal sandboxing restricts file system access to only your workspace folder and also lets you restrict network access to trusted domains only.[^c-f3a8cc0570]

title: Allow terminals to be opened in restricted workspaces
summary: When workspace trust is not granted, opening the terminal is blocked to protect the user from attacks where the shell may execute code such as by setting variables via an .env file.[^c-3d10dcb571] Security conscious users often configure their shells to prevent this from being a possibility, so there is a new opt-in setting that allows opening terminals in restricted workspaces.[^c-e1f99a395a]

title: New VT features
summary: The Kitty keyboard protocol has been implemented and will be rolling out to stable this release.[^c-4194595d3f]

title: Bracket matching foreground color
summary: You can now customize the text color of matching brackets using the new editorBracketMatch.foreground color theme token.[^c-90562ba106]

title: Select bracket and string content with double-click
summary: You can now double-click immediately after an opening bracket or immediately before a closing bracket to select all the content inside.[^c-32caa3bb7c]

title: Rename suggestions for TypeScript
summary: Rename suggestions for TypeScript now also work when typing over an existing declaration.[^c-5e6f843aaa] In the following video the user changes the declaration let index = 0; into let chunkIndex = 0; by typing the new identifier name instead of using the rename refactoring.[^c-2c10208574]

title: Improved ghost text visibility
summary: Inline suggestions (ghost text) now display a dotted underline when showing short suggestions of fewer than three continuous non-whitespace characters.[^c-6bd7185a49]

title: Improved shebang language detection
summary: VS Code now has improved shebang language detection support, particularly for files using /usr/bin/env with additional flags.[^c-bdbb3ed10f]

title: Integrated browser (Preview)
summary: VS Code has long included the Simple Browser for opening basic web pages, such as localhost sites during development.[^c-6d1be0bc83] However, because it relied on iframes, there were several limitations: website authentication wasn't possible, and common sites like Google, GitHub, and Stack Overflow couldn't be opened.[^c-c285563901]

title: Advanced settings
summary: You can now configure VS Code to always show advanced settings in the Settings editor without having to apply the @tag:advanced filter each time.[^c-c0b5e6fdaa]

title: Import profiles via drag and drop
summary: You can now import a settings profile by dragging and dropping a .code-profile file onto the VS Code window.[^c-0b61a66278]

title: Output channel filter improvements
summary: The Output panel filter now supports negative patterns and multiple filters.[^c-7474db9c56]

title: Filter problems by source
summary: The Problems panel now supports filtering by the source or owner of diagnostics.[^c-279834d5d0]

title: Include additional files in git worktrees (Experimental)
summary: When using background agents, a git worktree is created in order to isolate the changes.[^c-a9b3a5a960]

title: Collapse All action in SCM view
summary: When viewing files as trees in the Changes section of the Source Control view, you can now use the Collapse All action in the context menu of a root node to collapse all expanded directory structures at once, making it easier to navigate large sets of changes.[^c-0accececf9]

title: Git: Delete command
summary: A new Git: Delete command lets you run git rm on the currently open file directly from the Command Palette.[^c-34d20c0758]

title: Disable blame editor decoration hover
summary: You can now disable the hover popup that appears when you move the mouse over the inline Git blame decoration in the editor.[^c-775c7916c2]

title: Accessibility improvements
summary: The accessible view now dynamically streams chat response content as the AI model generates it.[^c-59a20386da] Screen reader users can follow the response in real time without needing to manually refresh or reopen the accessible view.[^c-317b8cf8ba]

title: Stable cursor position in the accessible view
summary: When content updates in the accessible view (such as during streaming chat responses or when using the terminal), the cursor position now remains stable.[^c-b358192b57]

title: ARIA alert for new chat sessions
summary: When a new chat session is created, screen reader users now receive an ARIA alert notification to inform them of the new chat context.[^c-fd6e907f04]

title: Improved tool call information in accessible view
summary: Tool calls in the accessible view now include more complete information, making it easier for screen reader users to understand what actions are being performed by AI agents.[^c-28e4c9636f]

title: GitHub Pull Requests
summary: There has been more progress on the GitHub Pull Requests extension, which enables you to work on, create, and manage pull requests and issues.[^c-261b13b9d3] Review the changelog for the 0.128.0 release of the extension to learn about everything in the release.[^c-856b5e68ab]

title: Finalized Quick Input Button Location APIs
Finalized Quick Input Button Toggle APIs
Continuous AI in practice: What developers can automate today with agentic CI
summary: Think of Continuous AI as background agents that operate in your repository for tasks that require reasoning.[^c-35a2a5bfed] Software engineering has always included work that’s repetitive, necessary, and historically difficult to automate.[^c-a618a3de02]

title: GitHub Actions: Self-hosted runner minimum version enforcement extended
Claude Opus 4.6 is now generally available for GitHub Copilot
summary: Claude Opus 4.6, Anthropic’s latest model, is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot.[^c-8505db129c] In early testing, Claude Opus 4.6 excels in agentic coding, with specialization on especially hard tasks requiring planning and tool calling.[^c-cb5802a122]
